authorization: Owner task on 2026-10-08 authorizes 25 unchanged development cases and 31 configurations after scorer/model prechecks.

qwen_cpu_runtime.input_rule: Require exact tokenized input <= 1024; never truncate.

resources.worker_isolation: one short-lived model process at a time; fixed before quality results

selection_safety_interpretation: Treat every covered must-have requirement conservatively as safety-relevant. Any per-case coverage loss or newly misleading/conflicting/geographically leaking finding versus another candidate blocks that candidate. No dominating candidate means an owner decision is required.
budget_scope: Complete unmodified _build_grounded_prompt, no chat-template overhead; locked llama-tokenize and Qwen3.5-2B GGUF; tokenization only.
threshold_calibration: Pool the 16 highest-ranked unique geographically allowed parent cosine scores for each of the 25 development questions; numpy.percentile method=linear; accept scores >= threshold. Freeze values before phase B packing/scoring.

packing.P1: Existing narrow branch expansion, adapted only to the explicit case jurisdiction; full packets atomic, corpus order, duplicate packets/passages skipped, continue ranked top-k seeds after budget rejection, no refill below k.
packing.P2: Ranked unique full parent passages, atomic whole-parent budget admission, no expansion/truncation/refill below k.
packing.P3: Ranked seeds; remove exact normalized-text duplicates. Expand a narrow branch only when it has at most 3 consecutive corpus passages and shares a non-root heading or consists only of continuations of one exact heading. Preserve the entire branch in source order atomically. Otherwise keep the whole parent. No fallback splitting after budget rejection; no gold, extra LLM, query rewriting or weights.

selection: Present separate quality and resource rankings. A provisional stage choice must be fully resolved and cannot lose a covered safety-related requirement or introduce a misleading/conflict/geography flag versus another eligible candidate. Prefer complete cases, micro then macro coverage; exact quality/flag ties prefer smaller index/model and CPU/RAM. Material tradeoffs stop for owner review; no posthoc percentage tolerance.
stop: Any judge/proof disagreement, unresolved review/uncertain, false positive without source support, identity/provenance/token failure, incompatible runtime, quota or material selection tradeoff stops advancement.
